name: Bad Blood
source:
Kat has lived her whole life in Hollowmere, a valley town where the sun arrives late and the church tower leans east.

Then something starts moving in the dark. And one night, under a bridge, a very polite stranger offers her a deal.

[From [url=https://lilshironeko.itch.io/bad-blood]itch.io[/url]]
